mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, name, description, created_by_user_uuid, created_at, updated_at, archived_at

d.uuid, d.external_id, d.organization_uuid, d.workspace_uuid, d.name, d.description, d.created_by_user_uuid, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.archived_at, v.uuid AS version_uuid, v.external_id AS version_external_id, v.version AS version_number, v.created_at AS version_created_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_cases AS case_row WHERE case_row.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND case_row.workspace_uuid = d.workspace_uuid AND case_row.version_uuid = v.uuid ) AS case_count

FROM evaluation_datasets AS d JOIN evaluation_dataset_versions AS v ON v.dataset_uuid = d.uuid AND v.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND v.workspace_uuid = d.workspace_uuid AND v.version = ( SELECT MAX(latest.version) FROM evaluation_dataset_versions AS latest WHERE latest.dataset_uuid = d.uuid AND latest.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND latest.workspace_uuid = d.workspace_uuid )
